newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Jardine Fleming sets warrants on 3 Taiwan shares.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming sets warrants on 3 Taiwan shares.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Securities said on Wednesday its Hong Kong unit launched eight million U.S.-style call warrants on shares of three Taiwan technology firms with an issue value of US$4.34 million.
The Taiwan firms are network product maker Accton, CD-ROM and digital video disc maker CMC Magnetic and notebook computer maker Inventec, Jardine Fleming said in a statement.
Issue price for the warrants was US$0.5420, with a strike price at US$32.845, it said.
The warrants have an underlying value of US$26.3 million.
Ten warrants control one basket and each basket comprises three Accton shares, four CMC Magnetic shares and two Inventec shares, it said.
The issue has a premium of 16.5 percent. The warrants expire on January 14, 1998. Minimum exercise lot is 10,000.
Jardine Fleming is a joint venture between Jardine Matheson Ltd and privately held British investment bank Robert Fleming.
